answers.q1: Go modules with make (Makefile) and the go toolchain; there is no lockfile beyond go.sum and no vendor directory. Install dependencies with: make install_deps (which runs `go get -v ./...`). Plain `go mod download` also works.
answers.q2: make test (runs install_deps, then `go test -v ./...`). Without make: go test -v ./...
answers.q3: go test -v ./doc -run 'TestGenMdDoc|TestGenMdDocWithNoLongOrSynopsis|TestGenMdNoHiddenParents|TestGenMdNoTag|TestGenMdTree'. The tests in md_docs_test.go are TestGenMdDoc, TestGenMdDocWithNoLongOrSynopsis, TestGenMdNoHiddenParents, TestGenMdNoTag and TestGenMdTree. Because TestGenMdDoc is an unanchored regex it also matches the others, so the shorter form `go test -v ./doc -run 'TestGenMd'` selects the same tests, provided no other file in ./doc has a test with a TestGenMd prefix.
answers.q4: CI runs three checks. (1) golangci-lint, version latest, with the config in .golangci.yml (gofmt and goimports formatters plus errcheck, goconst, gocritic, gosec, govet, ineffassign, misspell, nolintlint, staticcheck, unconvert and unused): `golangci-lint run --verbose` (or `make lint`). (2) License headers: `docker run -v $(pwd):/wrk -w /wrk ghcr.io/google/addlicense -c 'The Cobra Authors' -y '2013-2023' -l apache -ignore '.github/**' -check .`. (3) The Makefile has a `make fmt` target that checks gofmt, but the CI workflow does not call it. It is equivalent to `gofmt -l .`, which should print nothing.
answers.q5: None. I found no vendor/ directory and no 'Code generated' or 'DO NOT EDIT' markers in the repo. site/content and assets/ hold docs and an image, which are hand-maintained. Only go.sum is tool-managed, so change it with `go mod tidy` rather than by hand.
